Latin America runs some of the world's most competitive marketplace and delivery ecosystems. Topsort's deepest regional proof sits here, across multi-country retailers, marketplaces and agency-led demand.

Weee! is the leading U.S. online grocery retailer for Asian and Hispanic foods, delivering culturally specific fresh produce, pantry staples, and hard-to-find specialty items directly to customers. Founded in 2015, Weee! has rapidly become a go-to for underserved communities seeking authentic ingredients often absent in mainstream stores.

Weee! had developed an in-house advertising solution to support their growing marketplace, but as demand increased, they encountered limitations in scalability and self-service capabilities for sellers. They needed an infrastructure that could efficiently handle their expansion, simplify ad management, and provide sellers with transparency and control over their campaigns.

Since partnering with Topsort, Weee! seamlessly transitioned to a modern retail media platform in under a month. Sellers benefited from hands-on onboarding, enabling them to adapt quickly and optimize their campaigns with ease. Topsort’s robust A/B testing phase ensured a smooth rollout and maximized performance.
Improved shopper engagement drove significant growth.

Weee! is poised to continue expanding its retail media strategy with Topsort’s support. Future initiatives include exploring additional ad formats and enhancing data insights to provide sellers with even more actionable analytics.
"Our scalable and customizable retail media platform will provide their sellers with the tools they need to thrive while Weee! continues to focus on community and quality,"
